newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends steady to higher, focus on arb.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends steady to higher, focus on arb.

text.p: NWE gasoline ended steady to slightly higher, pulling back from its day's highs as NYMEX gasoline retreated and arbitrage interest at least temporarily lightened up, traders said on Wednesday.
"We've got healthy buying interest," in the barges, said one broker, who added that the arbitrage was beginning to close but supply may be absorbed in NWE.

Still, several barge traders said gasoline activity was lacklustre with prices whipsawed by crude and distillate prices and vulnerable to a selloff heading into December after the U.K. budget on November 26.
Heavy buying ahead of the budget and an expected tax rise of 3.0-3.2 pence on gasoline in the U.K. appeared to have lightened up, knocking away one crutch for prices.
Eurograde barges ended up $2 at $214/$216 fob ARA after trading as high as $220.50 for pipeline spec material, twice at $219 and at $218, traders said.
Regular unleaded finished down $1 at $203/$205 after trades at $207 and $208 fob ARA, they said.
Cargo offers were seen as high as $230 cif before ending at $226/$228, unchanged, as NYMEX gasoline fell.
